scenario.title: Cyber Security Baseline Assessment
scenario.description: Experience a simulated multi-domain security review. Your decisions will establish your default defense habits and identify training goals.

stages.title: Suspicious Security Alert
stages.description: You check your inbox in the morning and see a red alert from "BharatConnect Support Desk".

mockInterfaceData.subject: CRITICAL: Immediate Account Verification Required
mockInterfaceData.body:
Dear User,

We detected a security login attempt on your BharatConnect profile from St. Petersburg, Russia. To protect your linked accounts, you must click the link below and verify your identity within 2 hours. Failure to verify will result in permanent profile lock.

decisions.optionText: Inspect the sender email header, identify the fake domain (verify.in instead of .gov.in), and report the message.
decisions.explanation: Excellent action! You spotted the spoof domain header and reported it, avoiding the scam.

decisions.optionText: Delete the email immediately without clicking any links.
decisions.explanation: Deleting prevents account compromise, although reporting is the best security practice.

decisions.optionText: Click the "Verify Account Identity Now" link to review the security alert details.
decisions.explanation: Clicking the link exposes you to cloned websites. Always inspect domain headers first.

stages.title: Unsecured Profile Verification Page
stages.description: The verification button has redirected you to this form. Check the URL and connection security.

decisions.optionText: Enter simulated login credentials and verification code to unlock your profile.
decisions.explanation: Entering passwords on unencrypted HTTP cloned sites is a critical mistake, exposing credentials to theft.

decisions.optionText: Close the tab immediately after noticing the HTTP alert and mismatched browser URL.
decisions.explanation: Smart escape. Recognizing HTTP connection alerts and fake domains prevents credentials theft.

stages.title: Browser Security Update Notification
stages.description: While browsing, your web browser displays an official system banner regarding security patches.

mockInterfaceData.title: Browser Update Available
mockInterfaceData.body: A critical security update (v124.0.1) is available for Google Chrome. This update addresses active vulnerabilities in WebRTC. Click to restart and update.

decisions.optionText: Accept the restart and apply the official browser security update.
decisions.explanation: Applying updates is critical. This is a legitimate notification targeting WebRTC vulnerabilities.

decisions.optionText: Dismiss the update and block it as a suspicious phishing prompt.
decisions.explanation: False positive. Blocking official security updates keeps your device vulnerable to active exploits.

stages.title: Delivery Status SMS Alert
stages.description: You receive a text message regarding a pending courier delivery.

mockInterfaceData.body: ALERT: Your IndiaPost package is held at our warehouse due to incorrect address delivery notes. Please verify your address details immediately at http://indapost-update.click to release package.

decisions.optionText: Delete the SMS immediately. Check package statuses via the official post office app.
decisions.explanation: Excellent check. Courier scams use fake tracking links (.click domains) to collect money or details.

decisions.optionText: Click the tracking link to update your delivery address to avoid warehouse returns.
decisions.explanation: Clicking smishing links downloads malicious files or directs you to billing scam gateway portals.

stages.title: KYC Suspension Warning Call
stages.description: Your mobile phone rings. A caller claims to represent the Telecom Regulatory Authority.

mockInterfaceData.bodyText: "This is an automated warning call. Your mobile network connection will be suspended in 2 hours due to unauthorized Aadhaar link logs. Press 1 to speak with our verification agent to complete online KYC validation."

decisions.optionText: Hang up the call immediately. Verify SIM status directly with your network operator.
decisions.explanation: Excellent. Operators never call to threaten disconnection or request biometric updates.

decisions.optionText: Press 1, speak to the verification agent, and share the requested details to avoid deactivation.
decisions.explanation: Scammers pretend to represent authorities to steal identity and verification codes over call.

stages.title: Classifieds Buyer UPI Money Request
stages.description: You are selling a chair on OLX. The buyer sends you a payment alert on your UPI app.

mockInterfaceData.warningText: UPI Money Request: Confirm to receive funds.

decisions.optionText: Decline the payment request. Inform the buyer that UPI PINs are only entered to pay out, not receive.
decisions.explanation: Spot-on! Scammers send requests to pay, counting on victims to enter PINs without checking.

decisions.optionText: Approve the UPI app request and enter your PIN to claim the ₹5,000 credit.
decisions.explanation: Entering your UPI PIN authorizes a debit. Scammers use this QR/UPI scam to clean out seller accounts.

scenario.title: Cyber Security Final Assessment
scenario.description: Experience a broad simulated environment containing legitimate, suspicious, and malicious prompts. Your scores will measure your overall digital hygiene.

stages.title: The Freelance Offer (Morning)
stages.description: You receive an email pitching a high-paying part-time remote job task.

mockInterfaceData.subject: Job Offer: ₹15,000/Day for Simple Online Review Tasks
mockInterfaceData.body:
Dear Candidate,

Your profile has been shortlisted for our part-time online reviewer position. You can earn up to ₹15,000 per day by completing simple tasks. Click the button below to join our Telegram briefing group.

decisions.optionText: Verify the HR domain, identify it as spoofing, and delete the message.
decisions.explanation: Good. Urgency and extreme payouts are clear job scam vectors.

decisions.optionText: Click the link to join the Telegram briefing group.
decisions.explanation: Clicking directs you to scammers who request prepaid work tasks.

stages.title: System Security Update Notification (Afternoon)
stages.description: A notification appears on your device regarding a browser update.

mockInterfaceData.title: Google Chrome Update Service
mockInterfaceData.body: Google Chrome v124.0.1 is available. It includes critical security patches for 3 Zero-Day vulnerabilities. Restart now to apply.

decisions.optionText: Accept the restart and apply official Chrome security updates.
decisions.explanation: Applying official updates is crucial. This is a legitimate alert.

decisions.optionText: Dismiss the update and block it as a security threat.
decisions.explanation: False positive. Blocking legitimate security updates keeps your device vulnerable.

stages.title: Suspicious Software Update Prompt (Afternoon)
stages.description: A pop-up browser banner warns of critical system security errors.

mockInterfaceData.title: Critical Windows System Warning
mockInterfaceData.warningText: Your PC is infected with 3 critical Trojan files! Download "windows-defender-patch.exe" to clean system immediately.

decisions.optionText: Download and run "windows-defender-patch.exe" to clean system files.
decisions.explanation: Downloading EXE files from unauthorized browser banners compromises your device.

decisions.optionText: Close the browser tab immediately and ignore the fake warnings.
decisions.explanation: Excellent. Browser banners cannot scan your device; they are bait.

stages.title: Adaptive Segment
stages.description: Evaluating baseline profile to adapt assessment path...

mockInterfaceData.title: Loading assessment pathway...
mockInterfaceData.body: Please wait...

stages.title: Phishing Weakness Diagnostic Stage
stages.description: You receive an urgent message from your corporate team.

mockInterfaceData.body: WARNING: Your login token expires in 10 minutes. Click http://corporate-sso-verify.org to log in and renew access immediately.

decisions.optionText: Close the chat and contact the company IT helpdesk via phone to verify.
decisions.explanation: Excellent verification. Domain SSO-verify is spoofed.

decisions.optionText: Click the link and log in to renew your token.
decisions.explanation: Clicking spoof corporate SSO steals employee passwords.

stages.title: Financial Safety Weakness Diagnostic Stage
stages.description: You scan a payment QR code for parking, but the redirected URL looks suspicious.

mockInterfaceData.title: QuickPay Express Parking Checkout
mockInterfaceData.warningText: Please enter your bank netbanking password to settle parking dues.

decisions.optionText: Close the window. Pay the parking fees in cash or scan official counters.
decisions.explanation: Good. Parking portals never require Netbanking password entry.

decisions.optionText: Enter your Netbanking password to complete the payment.
decisions.explanation: Entering passwords on third-party HTTP portals is a critical mistake.

stages.title: Social Engineering Weakness Diagnostic Stage
stages.description: A vishing call claims your bank account is suspended due to high-risk transactions.

mockInterfaceData.bodyText: "This is Bank Security. We have detected a transaction of ₹50,000 on your card. To reverse this, we have sent a verification code to your phone. Please share it with us now to cancel the charge."

decisions.optionText: Refuse to share the code. Hang up and check your banking app directly.
decisions.explanation: Perfect. Banks never call to request OTPs to reverse charges.

decisions.optionText: Share the verification code to cancel the unauthorized charge.
decisions.explanation: Sharing codes allows attackers to authorize debits on your account.

stages.title: Credential Safety Weakness Diagnostic Stage
stages.description: An unsolicited SMS alerts you that your login password was changed.

mockInterfaceData.body: Alert: Your password was updated successfully. If you did not perform this change, click http://account-recovery-gmail.support to restore access.

decisions.optionText: Ignore the text link. Open Google Account settings directly to check password status.
decisions.explanation: Excellent. Recovery links in SMS texts are frequently spoofed.

decisions.optionText: Click the link and submit your recovery codes to lock the hackers out.
decisions.explanation: Entering recovery codes on fake portals compromises your account.

stages.title: Concert Tickets Checkout (Evening)
stages.description: You are completing a payment checkout for concert tickets.

mockInterfaceData.warningText: Merchant validation: Enter UPI PIN to authorize payment.

decisions.optionText: Decline to scan, and require standard escrow transactions or in-person cash handover.
decisions.explanation: Good. Verifying names and amounts keeps you secure.

decisions.optionText: Enter your UPI PIN to approve the transaction.
decisions.explanation: Entering your UPI PIN authorizes a debit. Always verify targets.

scenario.title: Your Digital Day: Baseline Assessment
scenario.description: Experience everyday digital situations from morning to night to establish your default cybersecurity habits before beginning training modules.
learningObjectives: Establish initial behavioral metrics across everyday digital decisions
Observe initial threat recognition and verification habits
Identify false positive and autopilot tendencies before training

stages.title: Salary Credit Alert
stages.description: You check your morning notifications and notice an SMS regarding your monthly salary deposit.

mockInterfaceData.title: HDFC Bank Alert
mockInterfaceData.body: Dear Customer, INR 68,500.00 credited to A/C ending XX4912 on 01-Sep-26 towards Salary. Clear Balance: INR 74,210.00. Thank you for banking with HDFC.

decisions.optionText: Acknowledge the notification and check account balance normally
decisions.explanation: Optimal. This is a routine, legitimate bank notification with accurate partial account digits.

decisions.optionText: Report SMS as fraud / attempt to block bank
decisions.explanation: Over-reporting error. Flagging an authentic bank credit notification creates unnecessary panic and service disruption.

decisions.optionText: Dismiss notification without checking
decisions.explanation: Acceptable disengagement, but reviewing verified account statements is standard financial hygiene.

stages.title: SpeedPost Delivery Notice
stages.description: You receive an SMS claiming an India Post parcel could not be delivered to your address.

mockInterfaceData.body: SpeedPost parcel #IN-84920 could not be delivered due to incomplete street address. Update house number within 12 hours at indiapost-resched.top to prevent immediate return to sender.

decisions.optionText: Click link immediately to update delivery address
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. The link points to an unauthorized non-government domain (indiapost-resched.top) designed to steal card details.

decisions.optionText: Open the official India Post website separately to track consignment number
decisions.explanation: Excellent independent verification. Using official channels (indiapost.gov.in) protects you from lookalike phishing links.

decisions.optionText: Delete the message without checking tracking status
decisions.explanation: Cautious avoidance prevents harm, but independent verification provides certainty regarding legitimate postal deliveries.

stages.title: Freelance Career Inquiry
stages.description: An unsolicited recruiter message reaches you on professional messaging offering flexible remote work.

mockInterfaceData.body: Hi there! We reviewed your profile and shortlisted you for our Part-Time App Reviewer position. Earn ₹15,000/week working 1 hour daily. To activate your starter pack and access corporate training materials, an onboarding registration fee of ₹499 is required.

decisions.optionText: Pay ₹499 upfront fee to secure the job position
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. Paying upfront fees for job offers is a hallmark of task-based employment fraud.

decisions.optionText: Decline the upfront payment and independently verify the job posting through the employer's official careers portal
decisions.explanation: Optimal contextual reasoning. Unexpected upfront payments and informal contact methods require independent verification through the employer's official careers portal.

decisions.optionText: Inquire about the fee within the same chat and request further details
decisions.explanation: Partial recognition. You noticed the unusual payment, but questioning a scammer within the same chat allows them to deploy persuasive social engineering scripts.

stages.title: UPI Cashback Collect Request
stages.description: While checking your payment app around lunch, a full-screen notification request appears.

mockInterfaceData.warningText: Message from requester: Enter UPI PIN to claim your ₹2,500 festive cash bonus.

decisions.optionText: Enter UPI PIN to authorize the transaction
decisions.explanation: Critical security mistake! Entering your UPI PIN always authorizes money leaving your account, never receiving cashback.

decisions.optionText: Decline the collect request on screen
decisions.explanation: Safe refusal. Declining the prompt prevents unauthorized debits from your bank account.

decisions.optionText: Decline the request and report the unknown VPA inside the payment app
decisions.explanation: Optimal response. Refusing the debit and reporting the fraudulent VPA protects the wider payments ecosystem.

stages.title: New Browser Sign-In Prompt
stages.description: A system dialog appears on your phone asking to verify a recent browser sign-in.

mockInterfaceData.title: Google Account Security
mockInterfaceData.body: New sign-in on Chrome (Windows) from your current city. Device: Desktop Workstation. Time: Just now. Was this you?

decisions.optionText: Review device and location on screen, confirm "Yes, it's me"
decisions.explanation: Optimal. Confirming legitimate activity after checking the device details and local timestamp maintains account access smoothly.

decisions.optionText: Panicked click on "No, secure account"
decisions.explanation: False positive reaction. Rejecting authentic sign-ins locks your own active sessions and triggers unnecessary password resets.

decisions.optionText: Dismiss prompt without reviewing
decisions.explanation: Neglecting authentication prompts leaves legitimate sign-ins unverified, creating potential security ambiguities.

stages.title: Document Scanner Permissions
stages.description: You install a third-party mobile document scanner utility, and an Android permission sheet pops up.

mockInterfaceData.title: QuickScan PDF Pro — Permissions
mockInterfaceData.bodyText:
QuickScan PDF Pro requests the following permissions:
• Camera (Capture documents)
• Contacts (Read address book)
• SMS (Read text messages)
• Location (Precise GPS coordinates)

decisions.optionText: Tap "Allow All Permissions" to proceed quickly
decisions.explanation: High-risk unreviewed acceptance. Granting SMS and Contacts access to a camera tool exposes private data and OTPs.

decisions.optionText: Review requested permissions, allow Camera only, and deny Contacts, SMS, Location
decisions.explanation: Optimal permission hygiene. Enforcing the principle of least privilege allows the app to function without compromising personal privacy.

decisions.optionText: Cancel installation and remove the application
decisions.explanation: Safe disengagement. Rejecting intrusive software is a solid defensive choice.

stages.title: Telecom Disconnection Call
stages.description: Your phone rings with an automated IVR call claiming urgent government regulatory action.

mockInterfaceData.bodyText: "This is an urgent automated alert from the Department of Telecommunications. Your primary mobile number is linked to 18 unauthorized SIM cards flagged in financial cybercrimes. All telecom services across your Aadhaar will be disconnected within 2 hours. Press 9 immediately to speak with the cybercrime verification officer."

decisions.optionText: Hang up and check connection status directly with telecom provider through official customer care
decisions.explanation: Optimal independent verification. TRAI and DoT never make automated disconnection calls; checking directly with your telecom provider verifies reality.

decisions.optionText: Press 9 in panic to connect with the investigation desk
decisions.explanation: Unsafe compliance. Pressing 9 routes your call directly to organized cyber fraud operators impersonating law enforcement.

decisions.optionText: Hang up immediately and ignore the call without independent verification
decisions.explanation: Cautious disengagement avoids immediate harm, though independently confirming your account standing provides complete assurance.

stages.title: E-Commerce Order Dispatched
stages.description: You check your email in the late afternoon and see a shipping update for an item you ordered yesterday.

mockInterfaceData.subject: Your package has shipped: Noise Cancelling Earbuds
mockInterfaceData.body:
Hi Rohan,

Good news! Your order #402-9182301-81923 has shipped via BlueDart. Tracking Number: BD84920194.

Estimated Delivery: Tomorrow by 8:00 PM.
You can track your delivery directly inside your Amazon account.

decisions.optionText: Review order status and delivery date normally
decisions.explanation: Optimal. This is a verified shipping confirmation originating from legitimate retail sender infrastructure.

decisions.optionText: Report dispatch confirmation email as phishing attempt
decisions.explanation: False positive reaction. Reporting legitimate purchase dispatch emails as phishing disrupts genuine merchant communications.

decisions.optionText: Archive email
decisions.explanation: Acceptable inbox management, though reviewing delivery details is routine digital hygiene.

stages.title: Digital Arrest Video Demand
stages.description: Having pressed 9 on the IVR call, you are connected to a high-pressure Skype video session.

mockInterfaceData.body: Officer Sharma on screen in uniform with police emblems: "A non-bailable arrest warrant has been issued under PMLA Section 45 against your identity. To avoid physical detention and remand, you must deposit ₹25,000 as a refundable security clearance bond into the Supreme Court escrow account immediately."

decisions.optionText: Disconnect call immediately and report the incident via official cybercrime channels
decisions.explanation: Decisive recovery. Indian law enforcement and courts never conduct 'digital arrest' or demand financial security bonds over video calls.

decisions.optionText: Transfer ₹25,000 security deposit to the provided clearance account
decisions.explanation: Extorted. Real police officers never accept funds, bonds, or clearance payments via electronic transfer.

decisions.optionText: Ask for written notice by official mail while keeping caller on hold
decisions.explanation: Partial resistance, but remaining engaged on the line allows extortionists to escalate intimidation and threats.

stages.title: Cafe Counter QR Sticker
stages.description: While paying for an evening snack at a local cafe, you scan the countertop payment stand with your UPI app.

mockInterfaceData.warningText: Notice: The paper sticker on the counter stand looks freshly glued and slightly misaligned over the store's original metal plaque.

decisions.optionText: Enter amount and pay without reviewing merchant name
decisions.explanation: Unsafe unreviewed acceptance. Tampered QR stickers redirect payments to fraudster bank accounts instead of the merchant.

decisions.optionText: Notice merchant name mismatch on payment screen, pause payment, and alert staff
decisions.explanation: Outstanding physical and digital verification. Checking the merchant name on your UPI screen before authorizing payments thwarts QR code tampering.

decisions.optionText: Pay with cash instead without reporting
decisions.explanation: Cautious personal protection, though alerting the shopkeeper prevents other customers from being defrauded.

stages.title: Streaming Auto-Renewal
stages.description: An email notification arrives claiming an unexpected charge for an annual streaming subscription.

mockInterfaceData.subject: Invoice Paid: ₹3,999 Annual 4K Membership Renewal
mockInterfaceData.body:
Thank you for renewing your Ultra HD 4K Annual Plan. A charge of ₹3,999 has been scheduled on your default card within 24 hours.

If you did not authorize this charge or wish to cancel your subscription immediately, click the cancellation link below:

[Cancel Subscription & Request Refund]

decisions.optionText: Click "Cancel Subscription" link in the email
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. The email uses artificial urgency and an unofficial sender domain (stream-premium-renew.com) to drive you to a credential-harvesting clone.

decisions.optionText: Spot fake sender domain and verify subscription status inside official app
decisions.explanation: Optimal verification habit. Never click renewal cancellation links inside emails; always verify subscription billing directly inside your official app account.

decisions.optionText: Delete email without checking account status
decisions.explanation: Cautious avoidance avoids the phishing site, though verifying your genuine subscription ensures you have no unexpected recurring debits.

stages.title: Friend's Emergency Medical Transfer
stages.description: You receive a late-evening WhatsApp message from a close friend's profile requesting immediate funds.

mockInterfaceData.body: Hey, are you free? I'm in a clinic with an urgent family emergency and my UPI daily limit is maxed out. Can you please send ₹4,000 to doctor-deposit@axl? I will transfer it back to you first thing tomorrow morning.

decisions.optionText: Send ₹4,000 immediately without verifying
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. Account takeovers on WhatsApp frequently exploit social trust and urgency to extort emergency funds from contacts.

decisions.optionText: Contact friend through an independent trusted channel, such as their normal cellular phone number
decisions.explanation: Strong independent verification. Calling your friend on their normal cellular line outside the messaging app immediately confirms whether their account was compromised.

decisions.optionText: Request additional confirmation or specific shared personal detail within the same chat
decisions.explanation: Partial verification. Asking a personal question in the chat adds some verification, but an attacker who has read previous message history may still answer convincingly.

decisions.optionText: Decline the transfer citing personal balance limits without verifying
decisions.explanation: Cautious avoidance avoids financial loss, though it misses the opportunity to establish truth if your friend genuinely needed help or their account was hacked.

stages.title: OS Critical Patch Notification
stages.description: As you wind down for the night, an official system update prompt appears on your device.

mockInterfaceData.title: Android System Security Update
mockInterfaceData.body: Security Patch Level: September 2026. Fixes critical kernel vulnerabilities and enhances Bluetooth encryption. Tap to restart and apply now.

decisions.optionText: Schedule or install official security update
decisions.explanation: Optimal. Promptly installing authentic operating system security patches closes zero-day vulnerabilities.

decisions.optionText: Block update service as potential spyware
decisions.explanation: False positive reaction. Disabling core system updates leaves your device vulnerable to known exploits.

decisions.optionText: Postpone update indefinitely
decisions.explanation: Neglecting essential security patches leaves known security holes unpatched on your device.

stages.title: Evening Closure
stages.description: Your digital day is complete. You have navigated routine communications, alerts, and interactions from morning to night.

mockInterfaceData.title: Your Digital Day: Daily Wrap-Up

decisions.optionText: View Your Digital Habits Breakdown
decisions.explanation: Transitioning to your personalized behavioral reveal.

To avoid physical detention and remand, you must deposit ₹25,000 as a refundable security clearance bond into the Supreme Court escrow account immediately."

decisions.optionText: Disconnect call immediately and report the incident via official cybercrime channels
decisions.explanation: Decisive recovery. Indian law enforcement and courts never conduct 'digital arrest' or demand financial security bonds over video calls.

decisions.optionText: Transfer ₹25,000 security deposit to the provided clearance account
decisions.explanation: Extorted. Real police officers never accept funds, bonds, or clearance payments via electronic transfer.

decisions.optionText: Ask for written notice by official mail while keeping caller on hold
decisions.explanation: Partial resistance, but remaining engaged on the line allows extortionists to escalate intimidation and threats.

stages.title: Cafe Counter QR Sticker
stages.description: While paying for an evening snack at a local cafe, you scan the countertop payment stand with your UPI app.

mockInterfaceData.warningText: Notice: The paper sticker on the counter stand looks freshly glued and slightly misaligned over the store's original metal plaque.

decisions.optionText: Enter amount and pay without reviewing merchant name
decisions.explanation: Unsafe unreviewed acceptance. Tampered QR stickers redirect payments to fraudster bank accounts instead of the merchant.

decisions.optionText: Notice merchant name mismatch on payment screen, pause payment, and alert staff
decisions.explanation: Outstanding physical and digital verification. Checking the merchant name on your UPI screen before authorizing payments thwarts QR code tampering.

decisions.optionText: Pay with cash instead without reporting
decisions.explanation: Cautious personal protection, though alerting the shopkeeper prevents other customers from being defrauded.

stages.title: Streaming Auto-Renewal
stages.description: An email notification arrives claiming an unexpected charge for an annual streaming subscription.

mockInterfaceData.subject: Invoice Paid: ₹3,999 Annual 4K Membership Renewal
mockInterfaceData.body:
Thank you for renewing your Ultra HD 4K Annual Plan. A charge of ₹3,999 has been scheduled on your default card within 24 hours.

If you did not authorize this charge or wish to cancel your subscription immediately, click the cancellation link below:

[Cancel Subscription & Request Refund]

decisions.optionText: Click "Cancel Subscription" link in the email
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. The email uses artificial urgency and an unofficial sender domain (stream-premium-renew.com) to drive you to a credential-harvesting clone.

decisions.optionText: Spot fake sender domain and verify subscription status inside official app
decisions.explanation: Optimal verification habit. Never click renewal cancellation links inside emails; always verify subscription billing directly inside your official app account.

decisions.optionText: Delete email without checking account status
decisions.explanation: Cautious avoidance avoids the phishing site, though verifying your genuine subscription ensures you have no unexpected recurring debits.

stages.title: Friend's Emergency Medical Transfer
stages.description: You receive a late-evening WhatsApp message from a close friend's profile requesting immediate funds.

mockInterfaceData.body: Hey, are you free? I'm in a clinic with an urgent family emergency and my UPI daily limit is maxed out. Can you please send ₹4,000 to doctor-deposit@axl? I will transfer it back to you first thing tomorrow morning.

decisions.optionText: Send ₹4,000 immediately without verifying
decisions.explanation: Unsafe. Account takeovers on WhatsApp frequently exploit social trust and urgency to extort emergency funds from contacts.

decisions.optionText: Contact friend through an independent trusted channel, such as their normal cellular phone number
decisions.explanation: Strong independent verification. Calling your friend on their normal cellular line outside the messaging app immediately confirms whether their account was compromised.

decisions.optionText: Request additional confirmation or specific shared personal detail within the same chat
decisions.explanation: Partial verification. Asking a personal question in the chat adds some verification, but an attacker who has read previous message history may still answer convincingly.

decisions.optionText: Decline the transfer citing personal balance limits without verifying
decisions.explanation: Cautious avoidance avoids financial loss, though it misses the opportunity to establish truth if your friend genuinely needed help or their account was hacked.

stages.title: OS Critical Patch Notification
stages.description: As you wind down for the night, an official system update prompt appears on your device.

mockInterfaceData.title: Android System Security Update
mockInterfaceData.body: Security Patch Level: September 2026. Fixes critical kernel vulnerabilities and enhances Bluetooth encryption. Tap to restart and apply now.

decisions.optionText: Schedule or install official security update
decisions.explanation: Optimal. Promptly installing authentic operating system security patches closes zero-day vulnerabilities.

decisions.optionText: Block update service as potential spyware
decisions.explanation: False positive reaction. Disabling core system updates leaves your device vulnerable to known exploits.

decisions.optionText: Postpone update indefinitely
decisions.explanation: Neglecting essential security patches leaves known security holes unpatched on your device.

stages.title: Evening Closure
stages.description: Your digital day is complete. You have navigated routine communications, alerts, and interactions from morning to night.

mockInterfaceData.title: Your Digital Day: Daily Wrap-Up
mockInterfaceData.bodyText: You have reached the end of your day. Every choice you made — what you noticed, where you verified, what you accepted, and where you hesitated — offers valuable insight into your everyday cybersecurity habits.

decisions.optionText: View Your Digital Habits Breakdown
decisions.explanation: Transitioning to your personalized behavioral reveal.
